sources.title: University of Tokyo General Library official inquiry form for pre-OPAC old-book item checks
sources.quality_notes: Form directly observed with required identity/status, confirmed email, inquiry category, question and CAPTCHA; official outside-user page routes uncatalogued classics here. A live form is not evidence of submission, source item or source text.

sources.title: University of Tokyo General Library official microform onsite booking and non-USB copying policy
sources.quality_notes: Microform use is booked by exact reel/fiche and subject to onsite conservation/copyright controls; no USB image export, permitted reproductions via reader/printer. Exact G23 printed/manuscript v52 surrogate not attested.
